issues.description: Method order violation: layout() (line 28) appears before requirements() (line 33). Code style rule 3 specifies standard order: export_sources → requirements → layout → source → generate → build → package → package_info. layout and requirements are swapped.
issues.fix_suggestion: Move requirements() before layout() to match the standard method order. Swap the two method blocks.

issues.description: Leftover template placeholder: `from conan.tools.microsoft import MSBuild  # placeholder to satisfy import check` imports a Windows-only build tool (MSBuild) that is irrelevant to this Linux/HarmonyOS PostgreSQL extension package. The comment 'placeholder to satisfy import check' indicates this was never cleaned up from a template. Violates code style rule 5 (禁止残留模板占位符).
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the entire line: `from conan.tools.microsoft import MSBuild  # placeholder to satisfy import check`

issues.description: patch_description format uses colon separator: "0001: Add varatt.h include for PostgreSQL 18 API compatibility". Code style rule 12 specifies patch_description should use space separation (not colon): e.g. "0001 Add varatt.h include for PostgreSQL 18 API compatibility".
issues.fix_suggestion: Change patch_description from "0001: Add varatt.h include for PostgreSQL 18 API compatibility" to "0001 Add varatt.h include for PostgreSQL 18 API compatibility" (remove colon after the 4-digit sequence number).

issues.description: Unused import: `import subprocess` is imported but never referenced anywhere in the file. Only os is used.

Return values of several fread() calls (lines 55, 59, 68, 90, 95) and malloc() calls (lines 57, 88, 93) are not checked. If memory allocation fails or file reads fail, the program would dereference NULL pointers or use uninitialized memory, leading to undefined behavior (e.g., segfault instead of a clean FAIL message).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add NULL checks after each malloc() call and check fread() return values, returning exit code 1 with a FAIL message on failure. Example: `char *shstrtab = malloc(shstrtab_shdr.sh_size); if (!shstrtab) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: malloc failed\n"); fclose(f); return 1; }`

issues.description: Compiler selection uses `os.environ.get("CC", "clang")` which reads from the Python process environment with a hardcoded fallback to "clang". The test_package only declares `generators = "VirtualRunEnv"` (line 18) but uses `env="conanbuild"` in self.run() (line 46). Without VirtualBuildEnv in generators, the conanbuild environment may not be generated, and CC may not be set from the Conan profile, causing the fallback to "clang" to be used silently. Consider adding VirtualBuildEnv to generators or using Conan's compiler settings directly.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add `"VirtualBuildEnv"` to generators (e.g., `generators = "VirtualRunEnv", "VirtualBuildEnv"`) to ensure the conanbuild environment (including CC) is properly generated, or use `self.settings.compiler` to determine the compiler.

issues.description: Main conanfile.py uses `env="conanbuild"` in self.run() (line 55) but does not declare any generators (no `generators` attribute). Without VirtualBuildEnv or equivalent, the conanbuild environment file may not be generated, potentially causing self.run() to fail when trying to load a non-existent environment file. The PGXS make invocation may still work via explicit PG_CONFIG path, but the build environment (CC, CFLAGS, etc.) may not be properly applied.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add `generators = "VirtualBuildEnv"` to the class attributes, or add a `generate()` method that creates the build environment, to ensure the conanbuild.env file is generated for use with env="conanbuild".

summary:
PASS — No P0 (deception) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. The Conan recipe for postgresql-url_encode 1.2.3 is functionally correct and free of deceptive practices.

Deception checks (all passed): (1) SHA256 in conandata.yml verified by downloading the actual PGXN source archive — hash 37e66baea9e56aece9ef5639ed61adedc557b410aab73f6e516031512bbf4ca1 matches exactly. (2) Test is not a stub — test_url_encode.c performs real ELF file parsing: validates ELF magic, checks ET_DYN shared object type, locates .dynsym/.dynstr sections, and searches for 5 exported symbols (Pg_magic_func, url_encode, url_decode, uri_encode, uri_decode). All 5 symbols confirmed present in the upstream source code. (3) No fake test pass — test() method runs the compiled test binary which exits non-zero on any assertion failure. (4) No fake status — test_package/MANIFEST.yml has no status field; version-level manifest.yaml status "published" is from a prior build. (5) No empty #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs. (6) No pre-compiled binaries in PR. (7) Source URL is official PGXN (api.pgxn.org) — verified accessible.

Recipe correctness (all passed): PGXS build system correctly used with pg_config from postgresql dependency. Package type "shared-library" is accurate (PG extensions are always shared). package_info sets cpp_info.libs and libdirs correctly. Patch 0001 adds varatt.h include — verified patch context matches source file at lines 15-19, legitimate PostgreSQL 18 API compatibility fix. No system library name conflicts. Conan 2.x API used correctly.

Issues found are 3× P2 (code style: method order, leftover MSBuild import, patch_description format) and 5× P3 (suggestions: unused import, unchecked return values, env/generator setup, manifest.yaml data quality). All are non-blocking improvements.
